title: Chunky Handling
content: “Chunky” or planar handling was especially popular with the classic illustrators when portraying men.Note the squarish planes around the cheekbone and the forehead in this detail by Tom Lovell. The treatment gives the feeling of a roughly carved wood sculpture.Also, note the alternation of edges: HARD-SOFT-HARD-SOFT as you go around the outside of the head.
